title: Normal transport through the common source diagonal
statement: In the etale correspondence v≫g=j≫f, restrict to O with factor maps jO and vO over the affine target V. For any affine diagonal geometries H and K, construct an isomorphism jO*normal(f,H)≅vO*normal(g,K) through the normal invariant of h=jO≫(f restricted to V). It uses only the Rees zero-fibre and smooth section exchanges and is independent of beta, localInverse, the DNC comparison delta, and all twist or compact-support normalizations.

proof.text: Cancel the monic inclusion of V to show vO≫gV=jO≫fV. Deduce that jO and vO are etale and separated by cancellation of their open inclusions and are quasi-compact since O is noetherian.
Set h=jO≫fV, which is smooth of dimension d. Compose the inverse comparison normal(h)≅jO*normal(fV) with normal(h)≅vO*normal(gV). These are exactly the Rees zero-fibre comparisons.

def normalTransport (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry f aY d V)
    (K : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry g aY d V)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j]
    (v : U ⟶ Z) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v]
    (w : v ≫ g = j ≫ f)
    (O : U.Opens) (jO : O.toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (vO : O.toScheme ⟶ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (hj : jO ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (hv : vO ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ v) :
    (OrientationRefinement.pull P jO).obj
        (OrientationRefinement.normal P f aY d V H) ≅
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P vO).obj
        (OrientationRefinement.normal P g aY d V K)
